authorization: User requested BRT/LRT Conditional Pass and conservative exclusion of Subway, based on existing local evidence, in this conversation.
decision_scope: Provisional scenario shortlist; not certification of construction feasibility

conditions.acceptance: Complete initial capital with consistent price/cash-flow basis, consultants excluded, within CAD16.657B. User cost envelopes are partial historical transfers, not full budgets.

Declare project start and critical path including property, utilities, approvals/design/procurement, fleet/depot, construction and testing; elapsed delivery <=9 years and operational by 2035-12-31. Justify overlap and avoid double-counting tests.
Demonstrate continuous route/stop/intersection/structure fit and property/utility mitigation within the cost and schedule envelope. Planned 36m ROW is not measured available width.
Identify compatible allocated storage AND maintenance, fleet and physical access, with initial capital and opening date. Do not assume spare Wilson or Finch West capacity.

alternatives.rationale: Retain a surface busway option for scenario analysis, conditional on full scope, route fit and garage/access delivery. Newmarket is a local construction-to-opening reference, not a complete target programme.

partial_cost_scenario.reference_price_basis: 2009 CAD provincial programme investment; fee/fleet/owner-scope unresolved
partial_cost_scenario.bound_provenance: User illustrative envelope; not a published project range or inflation adjustment

alternatives.comparative_engineering_assumption: Busway design may offer staging and fleet/garage integration options; no demonstrated universal width advantage over LRT on this corridor.

alternatives.rationale: Retain surface LRT under an explicitly tight delivery envelope. Finch West early utilities to opening is about nine years; that observation does not include all preceding development or guarantee Finch East delivery.

partial_cost_scenario.reference_price_basis: 2018 published nominal construction award component; complete owner capital and constant-dollar year unresolved
partial_cost_scenario.bound_provenance: User illustrative envelope; not a published project range or inflation adjustment

alternatives.comparative_engineering_assumption: Continuous guideway/platform/power space, utility relocations, property and a connected MSF must fit; no corridor-specific design verified.

alternatives.rationale: User adopts a conservative base-case policy against an unvalidated underground delivery programme and unallocated depot/access within nine years. Existing LRT duration and Line 1 depot needs motivate caution; neither proves a subway lower-bound duration or zero Wilson capacity.

partial_cost_scenario.reference_price_basis: User 500M-1B CAD/km arithmetic; complete scope and price year unresolved
partial_cost_scenario.bound_provenance: User assumption, not independently verified current Toronto unit-cost range

alternatives.reopen_when: Corridor-specific capital, full operational schedule, route design and allocated compatible depot/access satisfy all four original hard gates. No unquantified probability is represented as an engineering lower bound.

release_rule: Conditional Pass authorizes explicit scenario development and later provisional MCDA once comparable cost/demand/time inputs exist. It does not override a verified hard failure or certify implementation feasibility.
